profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself as a company that designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. It was founded in 2002, according to its site, with the stated aim of revolutionizing space technology and the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. The company is headquartered in Starbase, Texas, and is listed as a for-profit public company trading under the ticker SPCX. It also appears under the alias SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A.

The site material covers rockets and spacecraft rather than AI products specifically, and no AI products or MCP servers are attributed to the company in the available facts. Its public filings are recorded under CIK 0001181412.

On the legal side, no individual lawsuits are listed. Texas is identified as the state with the highest count of legal exposure, at 126.
